description: Who holds each UK Cabinet and Cabinet-level post right now, Prime Minister first: the post, department, minister, party, seat and start date, from the UK Parliament Members API. A live answer for "who is the current Chancellor / Health Secretary?" after reshuffles. Optional q filters by post, department or name. Cabinet and Cabinet-level posts only (about 28: Prime Minister, Chancellor, Secretaries of State, Chief Whip, Leaders of both Houses, Attorney General and a few others); junior ministers, most Ministers of State and Parliamentary Under-Secretaries are not covered. (cost: 1 credit)

q.description: string, optional, filter by words in the post, department or minister name (2-100 chars), e.g. "treasury"; default all posts

name: cabinet_ministers
